sources.title: HM Land Registry plans: title plan (practice guide 40, supplement 5)
sources.verified_claim: A title plan graphically supports the register and normally shows only the general extent; all title plans show general boundaries unless a boundary has been determined under section 60.

sources.title: HM Land Registry plans: boundaries (practice guide 40, supplement 3)
sources.verified_claim: HMLR guidance explains the legal and physical boundary distinction and the difficulty of identifying a precise legal line from ordinary plans.

sources.title: Practice guide 40: boundary agreements and determined boundaries
sources.verified_claim: General registration does not guarantee an exact legal boundary; a determined-boundary application requires evidence and a sufficiently precise supporting plan.

sources.title: National Polygon dataset - Technical specification
sources.verified_claim: The National Polygon Dataset indexes registered titles and describes index polygons as indicative locations; title plans and registers record general boundary positions unless determined.

sources.title: Index polygons spatial data (INSPIRE)
sources.verified_claim: INSPIRE polygons show the indicative position and extent of registered freehold property and use a Land Registry INSPIRE ID linked to a registered title.

sources.title: HM Land Registry MapSearch
sources.verified_claim: MapSearch can show whether land is registered and return title numbers and tenure, but HMLR states it does not carry indemnity; an index-map search is needed where indemnity is required.

sources.title: Search for land and property information
sources.verified_claim: The service provides title registers and title plans; the title plan includes location and general boundaries, while official copies are required when proof is needed.

sources.title: Title Descriptor dataset - Technical specification
sources.verified_claim: The title descriptor dataset exposes title number, estate interest, class and registered status and can include titles with registration applications not yet completed; descriptor status is not a parcel boundary proof.
